description:
Returns an issue priority. To fetch multiple priorities at once, use [Search priorities](#api-rest-api-3-priority-search-get) instead.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Permission to access Jira.

parameters.description: The ID of the issue priority.
parameters.name: id

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect.

404.description: Returned if the issue priority isn't found.
